shared_elements: figural motifs carved in low relief on a rock surface
repeated figures spread across a horizontal field
justification: The only correspondence is the wholly generic fact that both surfaces bear carved figural motifs distributed across a rocky face; A depicts a file of bearded, robed human figures in strict profile, facing one another and holding small handled objects, while B's carvings are curvilinear, spiral-filled abstract and animal-like forms with no procession, no clothing, no interaction between figures. Proportions and conventions are opposite: A is naturalistic modelled relief with careful anatomical and textile detail, B is schematic outline-and-scroll patterning.
